data.body:
fix-bug:investigation

DEFECT (a) — v1.0.0 legacy entries omit pr_number key: LIVE
File: plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py
Lines: 328-342 (reconstruct_from_pr_comments, v1.0.0 branch)
Root cause: The dict literal for v1.0.0 legacy entries (lines 333-339) does NOT include a 'pr_number' key. v1.1.0/v1.2.0 entries (lines 351-358) include 'pr_number'. Consumers iterating cycles[] and accessing entry['pr_number'] will raise KeyError on v1.0.0 entries; consumers using .get() silently omit the field. Inconsistent entry shape across the cycles array violates the schema contract.
Fix approach: Add 'pr_number': _SENTINEL_PR_NUMBER to the v1.0.0 entry dict at lines 333-339, matching the sentinel convention already documented in the module-level docstring (Backward-Compatibility section).
RED test plan: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py — add test_reconstruct_v100_legacy_entry_has_pr_number_sentinel() that mocks subprocess.run returning a v1.0.0 marker comment, calls reconstruct_from_pr_comments(42, 'owner/repo'), and asserts cycle['pr_number'] == 0 (or imports _SENTINEL_PR_NUMBER from cycle_ledger). Must FAIL before fix (KeyError or missing key) and PASS after.

DEFECT (b) — missing encoding='utf-8' on file open: LIVE
File: plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py
Line: 166 (_open_lock function)
Root cause: os.fdopen(fd, 'r') at line 166 does not specify encoding='utf-8'. On platforms where the default locale is not UTF-8 (Windows, some CI environments), reading the lock file could fail or produce garbled bytes. The sibling call at line 139 (in _atomic_write, os.fdopen(fd, 'w', encoding='utf-8')) correctly specifies the encoding. Inconsistency between the two fdopen calls is the defect.
Fix approach: Change line 166 to os.fdopen(fd, 'r', encoding='utf-8').
RED test plan: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py — add test_open_lock_uses_utf8_encoding() that inspects the os.fdopen call in _open_lock via monkeypatching os.fdopen, calls write_ledger or append_cycle, and asserts the call to fdopen for the lock file included encoding='utf-8'. Alternatively, use ast.parse to assert the keyword arg is present (purely structural, no runtime needed). Must FAIL before fix (no 'encoding' kwarg) and PASS after.

DEFECT (c) — hardcoded model id: STALE (never present)
After exhaustive search across all git history for plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py using git log -S'haiku', git log -S'claude', AST walks, and grep — there is NO hardcoded model ID in cycle_ledger.py at any point in its history. The bug report likely conflated cycle_ledger.py with other files in dso_ci_review/ (aggregator.py line 35 has _DEFAULT_AGGREGATION_MODEL = 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', region_split.py line 553 has arch_model = 'claude-opus-4-7', runner.py lines 2071-2074 have _TIER_MODEL_DEFAULTS dict). These are out of scope per task instructions. VERDICT: STALE+SHA=N/A (was never in cycle_ledger.py).
